Both initial contexts in the first scoped batch incorrectly proposed that unbound au-
thority was available. The validator rejected those responses and the bounded repair
loop retained the correction and original failures. The complete report retains unan-
swered source and performance questions; it grants no automatic release or uncondi-
tional legal-correctness claim. Human answers or approval are not quality evidence
under the current product requirement. The source-case comparisons are descriptive
and conditional on proposed factual mappings. No statistically supported ranking
or future-error probability follows. The missing reference answers include different-
question programs, incomplete generation and unresolved facts. Their count is there-
fore a coverage finding, not an estimate of English interpretation error. An unaligned
program does not earn credit for abstaining from a question it never implemented.
The unfamiliar-source study did not complete its required investigations within the exe-
cuted limits. Its failed phase remains failed. The later assessment preserves all selected
tasks and reports unfinished processing; successful software regression or document
production cannot turn that failure into a completed study. The complete execution
record identifies the exact resource veto and the remaining claim–reading pairs.
6.36 Preserving the whole investigation under
bounded processing
The unfamiliar-source investigation encountered a failure before any legal disagree-
ment could be assessed. A reader quoted the authentication circular with ordinary
spaces where the retained document contained nonbreaking spaces. A later response
substituted null characters. The source validator rejected both. Rejection preserved
the evidence boundary, but repeated requests to copy the same characters spent the
allowance without answering the interpretive question. Exact copying is work that soft-
ware can perform deterministically.
The September continuation separates that task from deciding what a passage means.
Before asking a reader for evidence, the software gives each retained source unit an
identifier. It also offers bounded adjoining spans for longer units. The reader selects
identifiers; the software retrieves the corresponding characters from the unchanged
source. Every selection is bound to the source edition and the particular request. An
identifier from another request, an altered source, a repeated selection, or disjoint frag-
ments presented as one quotation is rejected. The whole source remains available to
the reader, so selecting a short passage does not remove a remote exception from the
context.
For an engineer, the coordinate convention matters. A span starts at one Unicode code-
point and ends immediately before another. These are neither UTF-8 byte offsets nor
Java UTF-16 offsets. In a string containing an astral character, those coordinate systems
give different lengths. The implementation uses precomputed identifiers rather than
asking the reader to count positions. Nonbreaking spaces, combining characters, car-
riage returns and line feeds survive unchanged. If a selected fragment occurs more
than once in its unit, the reader must select enough adjoining context to distinguish it

or select the whole unit. This preserves the earlier quotation contract.
An authentic quotation can still be irrelevant.
After retrieval, the original source-
support and question-correspondence checks therefore run unchanged. A reader may
select the correct paragraph while leaving its support for the proposition unestablished.
That is a valid uncertain result. The resolver never changes such a judgment to sup-
ported merely because the identifier was valid. Both the original identifier response
and the resolved quotation response are retained, allowing a later investigation to
distinguish transcription failure from a disputed reading.
6.36.1 Give every question an initial hearing
Consider three batches of source claims, two initial perspectives per batch, and a budget
of six requests. A schedule that completes both initial and follow-up rounds for the first
batch can consume four requests there. Only two requests then remain for the second
batch; the third receives no assessment. An exception in that last batch would remain
unseen even if the early readers agreed enthusiastically.
The implemented round-first option offers both initial perspectives to every batch be-
fore allocating follow-up depth. Under the same six-request workload, it reaches all
three batches. Both perspectives in a round receive the same earlier evidence; the first
answer in the current round is withheld from the second. Invalid responses remain
recorded, and every unattempted pair remains in the denominator. A transport inter-
ruption preserves the consumed attempt. Changing a partition or response schema
cannot replenish a source issue’s attempt allowance or restart its oldest deadline.
This ordering improves a specific accounting property: eligible initial work is not dis-
placed by routine follow-ups on an earlier batch. The deterministic comparison does
not establish a ranking in legal accuracy. An early objection may still matter more than
a later routine question, and the current policy does not pretend to estimate that legal
importance. It preserves the questions so that capacity limits cannot silently choose
which ones disappear.
6.36.2 A small executable answer must not replace the circular
The authentication baseline attempted to return one interpretation and a 263-unit cov-
erage table in the same response. The split-reader option now asks first for the inter-
pretation and its exact questions. Each question names the actor, assessment unit, tem-
poral basis and output meaning. Bounded responses then account for the source units
against that unchanged reading. A response may link a unit to several questions, clas-
sify it as context with a reason, or retain uncertainty. Dependencies on units in other
pieces remain explicit.
Merging is deterministic. Every required unit must occur once; invented, duplicate or
missing identifiers fail. The merger retains every cross-piece concern. A final whole-
source response must account for each concern and each declared question. It may
retain the reading with uncertainty or propose a revision. A revised reading has a new
209

identity, so the previous correspondence table cannot certify it. The implementation
rechecks coverage, subject to the same nonrefundable source-unit limits, or reports the
remaining work.
This is also a guard against answering the wrong question well. Suppose a program
answers whether a material investment-policy change needs prior approval. A separate
transitional question asks how an application already pending at the effective date is
processed. Both outputs may be Boolean, but they are different decisions. The coverage
record cannot attach the first program to the second question merely because the types
agree. An unencoded question remains visible beside an executable proposal. The
declared question inventory is itself a proposed reading of the source; exact accounting
cannot prove that the reader identified every possible legal issue.
The retained authentication source also reveals the distinction between input capacity
and response capacity. Its 263 units and the initial reference schema occupied 261,822
request bytes before earlier interpretations or coverage results were supplied.
The
single-reader limit is 200,000 bytes, so dividing the response table alone did not remove
the input limit. A deterministic diagnostic using the existing locator-compaction func-
tion preserved all unit identifiers, text and normative flags while reducing the initial
transport to 153,212 bytes. The subsequent repair connects that function to the optional
split-reader path. It explicitly distinguishes the original packet identity, which the cov-
erage result must name, from the compact transport identity used by the reference table.
Tests reject their substitution and check that the 263-unit initial request fits. Later whole-
source reconciliation still has a size limit; a completed authentication investigation does
not follow from the smaller initial request alone.
A deterministic capacity exercise then carried that exact packet through all coverage
pieces using deliberately synthetic proposals. It retained all 263 source units and one
cross-piece concern for each. Their whole-source consistency request occupied 382,396
bytes and stopped at the input limit, preserving the coverage and concerns. This is
a measured final-context failure, not a completed interpretation. The next processing
repair must reduce repeated representation while retaining the information needed to
examine interactions among the concerns, or state an explicitly narrower supported
capacity. Deleting concerns or labelling the completed pieces as a completed circular
would give a misleading result.
6.36.3 Extend arithmetic without changing the proposed meaning
One retained private-market-fund proposal used four addition operands where the
compiler previously accepted exactly two. Let D and I denote the proposal’s direct
and indirect exposure quantities in the same exact valuation unit. Its expression was
D+I +D+I. The repeated terms represent a proposed doubling of aggregate exposure
for comparison with NAV. Whether those exposure definitions and that classification
rule follow from the circular remains a source question. A compiler repair must pre-
serve the expression it receives, including every repeated operand.
The extension defines addition as an ordered fold. For operands x1 through xn, first

relation is

(6.12)
For D = 25 and I = 25, the four terms sum to 100. Deduplicating the operands would
give 50 and change the proposed test. Existing binary expressions retain their previous
representation; subtraction and multiplication do not gain additional arities by analogy.
Expanded expression size and depth are checked before a compiler is invoked.
The arithmetic theorem uses exact unbounded integers and a tagged missing value.
Adding a missing operand yields missing. By induction over the remaining operand
list, the ordered binary fold equals the specified n-ary operation; if every operand is
known, it equals the integer sum; if any operand is missing, the result is missing. Lean
checks these statements. The recorded proof names its standard logical dependencies
explicitly. A separate constructor check compares the independently parsed proposal
with the emitted model, while Java and Catala execute finite challenges, including neg-
ative values and integers larger than machine integers. Conflict, applicability and time
selection retain their separate semantics and checks; the addition theorem does not es-
tablish them by integer associativity.
The twenty-operand challenge also exposed an implementation problem outside arith-
metic: the schema validator recursively explored alternatives whose required operator
already contradicted the expression. The repair discards only those logically impossible
alternatives and retains the original schema checks for every remaining branch. Com-
parisons against the original validator and the unchanged backend challenge check that
this processing repair does not weaken acceptance.
6.36.4 State what each completed check establishes
The investigation can now attach the exact source, proposed reading and question to
the shared machine-qualification route. A supported formal proposition receives its
checked domain and premises. An unencoded reading, an unavailable authority or an
unresolved source question remains qualified. A formal theorem can be obtained while
the product still withholds translation because source dependencies remain unresolved.
Separate hypothetical execution may investigate that expression under declared math-
ematical inputs, but it does not remove the product’s unresolved conditions.
Applying the adapter to all nine retained UCITS readings illustrates a different limit.
Eight readings contain a date fact, which the current constructor proof does not sup-
port; the ninth has no executable formalization. Every reading also retains unresolved
source questions. The adapter verified all nine identity-bound qualification records, re-
porting eight unsupported formal profiles and one unencoded proposal. It reported
zero executed target cases. A preliminary Boolean-only challenge generator stopped
as soon as it encountered the date fact; it did not replace that fact with a convenient
date. Thus the new adapter accounts for the actual proposals without presenting a
finite Boolean test or the integer-addition theorem as a proof about dates.

Numeric and date mappings also require a declared comparison domain. The domain
record names every common fact, its type and unit, the listed values, and whether they
are mathematical probes or an expressly declared finite domain. A separating case is
replayed through the original programs. Matching probes establish no result outside
those listed values. The system neither extracts a convenient domain from expected
answers nor turns a source quotation into proof that a finite list exhausts the institution’s
possible facts.
Historical failures remain part of this account. The earlier unfamiliar-source phase com-
pleted none of its four whole ensemble investigations, despite the passing software
regression. The continuation implements and tests specific processing repairs and pur-
sues only live issues whose original limits permit another request. It does not rename
the earlier failed phase as successful. Changes to the method also prevent its new re-
sults from entering the earlier frozen prospective window as if its method had remained
unchanged. English interpretation and unknown future circulars continue to receive ex-
plicit qualifications until the corresponding propositions and premises have support.
6.36.5 What the live continuation actually resolved
The repaired live route used the remaining 37 authorized reservations. One provider
stream disconnected; its reservation remained spent. The resumed run reused nine
completed responses under their original identities before making further calls. It com-
pleted both initial perspectives for all fifteen selected batches and then six follow-up re-
sponses, with no current-round answer shown to its paired reader. Of the 36 returned
responses, 27 passed the response contract and nine were rejected. All returned source-
span selections resolved; the rejections concerned executable quotations, unencoded
candidates or inconsistent assessment dimensions.
Those failures matter. In several batches, both initial readers assessed an executable
omission for a candidate that had no executable representation. Agreement between
them did not supply the missing program. The validator rejected the assessment and
preserved both explanations. In another case, both readers questioned whether keeping
a pending application under the existing approval process implied that the proposed
substantive relief was unavailable. One retained unassessed correspondence; the other
proposed a conflict. The source, exact question and disputed inference remained at-
tached to both views.
The combined old and new evidence covers both validated perspectives for 165 of the
225 UCITS claim–reading pairs, compared with 48 before the continuation. Sixty pairs
still lack a complete validated review. The continuation itself has 90 pairs with all
four assessment dimensions filled; completing those fields does not establish that their
judgments are correct. The final reconciliations retain 42 disputes. The original 500-
reservation grant is exhausted, so further live investigation stops with those questions
visible.
The master also detected concurrent additions to separate repository components dur-
ing execution. Its unchanged-tree condition failed even though all 424 files in the re-

failed. A separately recorded final assessment checks the retained evidence, documents

An interpretation revision reopens its coverage checks. Failed requests keep their spent attempts; no batch
disappears to fit the budget.
The qualification adapter checks supported formal propositions for a retained reading
and exact question. The complete ensemble investigation invokes it when enabled; the
split single-reader path retains proposals for subsequent checking. A source identi-
fier proves where the words came from. Coverage proves that the declared units and
questions received dispositions. A formal theorem proves its stated relation. None of
these alone proves the English interpretation. The four earlier unfamiliar investigations
therefore remain incomplete unless their remaining stages actually execute under the
recorded limits.
